PF_LNL_TILES.what: the per-arch tile table the module reads at import (the pinned triton.autotune configs); default = the core's carried kernels/lnl_fused.tiles_by_arch.json beside the module; an override path for a caller that pins a different table (opt_core.attn.pair_fused exports the carried path explicitly)

license: in-house Triton/Gluon kernels (no third-party kernel bytes); tile table carried beside the module as lnl_fused.tiles_by_arch.json
name: lnl_fused

not_carried.adapter and measurement programs: the engine adapter and the measurement programs written around the kernels (engine wiring, not kernels)

served_note: fused_transition(x, ln_w, ln_b, W1, W2, W3, eps, residual): C in {64,128} (gl.static_assert), hidden = W1 rows, chunked on-chip; ln_linear(x, ln_w, ln_b, W[NOUT,C], eps, write_y, transpose): C in {64,128}, NOUT constexpr; gate_transpose(o[B,L,L,C], g_src[..,GS] at column offset, transpose): bf16(sigmoid(g)*o) with transposed row order
version: lnl_fused (LN+Linear fused pair kernels v3: fused_transition, ln_linear + gate_transpose; Gluon/Triton, sm90 tiles)
